draft.overall: NXL leads the session at 14:30 ET, up 68 percent from the prior close, with fresh news found in our sources: a 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America. NAMM is next among the covered gainers, up 51 percent, with fresh news found in our sources (first-half results and an operating update), and it printed a new high of day since the previous checkpoint. EJH is up 28 percent, with fresh news found in our sources about an AI service robot launch paired with a private placement. Fresh news was found in our sources for 6 of the 12 names the desk covers.

lines.text: Nexalin announced a definitive 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America at 08:30 ET, October 1, 2026, which it framed as a step toward commercial revenue. The desk reads it as a company-specific commercialization story, but the excerpt gives no contract value, minimum purchases or revenue figure, and it does not establish what conditions must be met before revenue is realized.

No fresh catalyst: only older news was found in our sources, the September 3, 2026 retail launch of Perfecta plant-based meat in the Northeastern U.S., described as its first U.S. store-shelf placement. No sales, store-count or contract-value figure was disclosed, and no later company announcement tied to this session is on file.

Airship AI announced $29.0M of firm-fixed-price, brand-name-only contract awards from a Department of Homeland Security agency at 09:00 ET, October 1, 2026. The desk reads the award as material against the $4.12 million of revenue reported for Q2 2026, but delivery timing, revenue-recognition timing and the specific agency are not established.

The company's Form S-3 shelf, covering up to $50.0 million of stock, preferred stock and warrants, became effective on September 30, 2026. That is financing capacity only: no takedown, offering or sale is documented, and the evidence does not show the shelf caused the price move. It is down 17.4% since the previous checkpoint.
Research is not on file for this name at this checkpoint, so no catalyst is stated.

No fresh catalyst: the older item in our sources is the completed sale of Altruis Benefit Consulting, reported in an 8-K at 17:51 ET, September 29, 2026, for $8 million in cash plus an earnout of up to $1 million. The desk reads it as added liquidity, but the effect on revenue, earnings and debt is not quantified and the earnout amount is unknown.

E-Home announced the launch of a dedicated AI service robot for China's household-services market at 07:15 ET, October 1, 2026, alongside a September 29 private-placement agreement for 71.8 million shares at $0.60 (stated gross proceeds $43.08 million). The desk notes the placement is substantial prospective supply, and the evidence does not show it has closed.

No fresh catalyst: the latest company-specific item in our sources is warrant-related, with Series A warrants exercisable since September 18, 2026, which is dilutive rather than favorable. The last clinical update found was enrollment of the 500th ELAINE-3 subject on August 26, 2026, and nothing found corresponds to the live move.

Namib Minerals reported first-half 2026 results and an operating update at 08:00 ET, October 1, 2026, with revised production guidance, higher reported AISC and $11.3 million of non-cash revaluation losses. It followed a $6.5 million non-dilutive term loan announced September 29. The desk reads the outlook and costs as adverse and the loan as non-equity funding, and our sources do not tie the price move to any one of these. Since the previous checkpoint it printed a new high of day.

No fresh catalyst: the older item in our sources is a closed best-efforts offering of 12,000,000 Class A shares at $0.80, for approximately $9.6 million gross, on September 28, 2026. That is confirmed new issuance and a dilutive supply event, and nothing found explains the current positive move.
